user.title: Configure ambient sensors
user.description:
Comfort Advisor compares the indoor and outdoor comfort levels to suggest when windows can be open.

Tip: you can use current temperature and humidity sensors from a weather integration if you don't have outdoor temperature and humidity sensors.

comfort.title: Configure comfort settings
comfort.description:
The [Summer simmer index]({simmer_index_url}) is a modern heat index equation. For SSI values between {ssi_70} and {ssi_77}, most people are comfortable, but slightly cool. From {ssi_77} to {ssi_83}, nearly everyone feels quite comfortable, while from {ssi_83} to {ssi_91} most are comfortable, but slightly warm.

[Dew point temperatures]({dew_point_url}) tell the absolute quantity of moisture that is in the air, thereby indicating how humid it will feel outside to our bodies. On the other hand, relative humidity only tells us how saturated the air is compared to how much it can hold at the current temperature.

data.pollen_max: Highest comfortable pollen level (if available from weather provider).
data.cooling_temperature_min: Lowest outdoor temperature for cooling with outside air

data_description.cooling_temperature_min: When the house is warmer than comfortable, cooler and drier outdoor air is let in even if it's below the comfortable range, but never below this temperature.
data_description.temperature_tolerance: How much outdoor air may work against the heating or cooling before comfortable outdoor air is no longer let in.
data_description.hysteresis: Once windows can be open, they stay open until the simmer index, dew point, cooling temperature or indoor/outdoor comparison is past its limit by this much. Prevents switching back and forth near a limit.
data_description.humidity_hysteresis: Once windows can be open, they stay open until the humidity is above its maximum by this much.

reconfigure.title: Change weather provider and sensors
reconfigure.description: Changing the sensors keeps the existing Comfort Advisor entities and settings.

error.invalid_units: The sensor must report temperature in °C, °F or K, or humidity in %.
error.simmer_index_range: The lowest comfortable simmer index must be below the highest.

abort.already_configured: An integration with the same input sensors already exists.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The weather provider and sensors were updated.
